### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**11** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `619c2c1617a76c198a0e2ac0ec6dd24460b71beb` — the merge of head `76fb831b21a0a33437622b3828730967f54a50fc` into base `35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 619c2c1617a76c198a0e2ac0ec6dd24460b71beb && git checkout 619c2c1617a76c198a0e2ac0ec6dd24460b71beb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796 76fb831b21a0a33437622b3828730967f54a50fc && git checkout -B drift-repro 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796 && git merge --no-ff 76fb831b21a0a33437622b3828730967f54a50fc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：对象上的“汇总”字段如果是把子记录里普通的本币金额加起来（比如工时单把各条工时的成本相加），现在可以声明为本币，页面上会带货币符号显示，不再是一个光秃秃的数字。
- 为什么做：以前这种声明会被校验拒绝，导致汇总金额和旁边的金额格式对不上。
- 出错会怎样：只是多放行一种以前被拒的写法；原来能用的写法都不变，其他货币写法照样被拒。
- 要你做什么：不需要你做任何事。它放宽了元数据的规则，席位会安排一次约定审核，然后由区域落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `76fb831b21a0a33437622b3828730967f54a50fc` · 2026-11-19T08:22Z

- **形态** — 18 files, +312/−144:
  - spec: `record-currency-path.ts`, `stack.zod.ts`, `object.zod.ts`, `field.zod.ts`, plus the `api-surface` / `export-origins` / `liveness` ledgers.
  - objectql: `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`.
  - docs: five pages.
  - tests and one changeset.
  Base `24cc61fa`, K=14 (< 15). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 35387`: not governed, under the 3000-line limit. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; `spec` minor, `objectql` patch. Both levels are right for the kind.
- **Fixes vs card #35045, per seat ruling record 7000258793**:
  - New exported predicate `isTenantCurrencyAmount(def)`: `type === 'currency'` and `currencyMode ?? 'dynamic'` is `'dynamic'`.
  - Case (d) in both doors now reads it in place of `storedHomeAmountSourceOf`: `defineStack` via `stack.zod.ts`, and the engine registry's `followRefusalsOf` at both ends.
  - **Strictly widening, checked**: the object door's own home-candidate test (`refuseDishonestHomeAmount`, `isHomeCandidate`) already requires a `homeAmount.field` to be a `currency` field in `dynamic` mode. So every child field admitted before is admitted now, and nothing that passed is refused.
  - Still refused, unchanged: `record` and `fixed` children, `number`, `formula` and `summary`.
  - The prescription in `recordCurrencyDynamicRollupNotHomeError` now names the child by its type and lists its home-currency amounts. Its record-mode arm keeps `storedHomeAmountSourceOf` to name the home amount to roll up.
  - The `field.zod.ts` describe and the object-door sentence now speak of the admitted set.
  - The liveness row gains a WIDENED entry. Its reader `summaryDeclaresCurrency` is unchanged and already true for any `dynamic` summary, so LIVE holds.
- **Changeset** — read sentence by sentence against the diff; all of these match:
  - the newly admitted declaration and its reason (D4's tenant `localization.currency`);
  - the old refusal text;
  - one predicate for both doors;
  - the unchanged list: no inference without `currencyConfig`, plus the record, fixed, number, formula and summary refusals;
  - the moved wording of the refusal head and prescription;
  - the levels.
  `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` names `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` eval 20. That path is governed, so it goes to the seat (below).
- **Pins**:
  - `currency-summary-home-rollup.test.ts` admits:
    - sum / min / max / avg over a plain `dynamic` child amount, writable, readonly or computed;
    - over a readonly plain amount beside a record-mode amount with no `homeAmount`;
    - a plain `dynamic` amount whatever a `homeAmount` says of it.
  - It refuses:
    - a `number` child, naming the home-currency amounts;
    - a `summary` child, even a `dynamic` one;
    - a record-mode child without a home amount, prescribing `homeAmount`;
    - a forged `homeAmount` on a `number` or a `fixed` child.
  - CONTROL: a summary declaring nothing has no currency.
  - `record-currency-guards.test.ts` (engine door):
    - registration in either order;
    - a child re-saved out of the admitted set is refused, naming the roll-up, and a run that leaves a refused pair as it was is not refused for it.
- **门禁** — 70 check-runs on this head: 60 success, 10 skipped, 0 failure.
- **接受的偏差** — none.
- **范围外去向** — the stale eval 20 expected output is on a governed path, so it is routed to seat 5 with this record.
- **L2 owed (routing)** — `Clause-②: yes (widening)` plus non-test `packages/spec/src/**` → a contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER. Routed to seat 5.
- **落地条款** — not governed. data-2 lands after the seat's L2 record. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.
